_comment: Documentation-sync policy for spiderweb-pr (thehub-pr ADR 0010). Read by tools/check_docs_sync.py. couplings: when a covered path changes, the doc must change in the same diff, or the commit/PR says 'Docs-Impact: none - <reason>'. Seeded conservatively: each coupling was replayed over this repo's recent human-authored changes and never fired. Two candidates were measured and left out because they fired on routine work: docs/README.md <- docs/*.md (4 of 48 changes, 1 with the index updated) and docs/SCHEMA_AND_EXPORT_CONTRACTS.md <- schemas/*.json (8 of 48, never with the doc updated). Add couplings for docs that enumerate things; do not add ones that fire on routine work.

couplings.why: 'Desktop app' lists one double-click launcher per platform.
'Quick start' and 'Development gates' run run_all.py inside code blocks that the reference check does not read.
